title: Binding of Isaac on Mount Moriah
summary: God tests Abraham by commanding him to offer Isaac on a mountain in the land of Moriah; the Angel of the LORD stops him and a ram is provided (Gen 22).
description: Abraham offered Isaac "by faith" (Heb 11:17-19). Scripture gives no year. Ussher dates it 2133 AM (Isaac 25, following Josephus); Jordan suggests about 2130.

sorting_basis.note: Tier 3: Ussher-Jones (Floyd Nolen Jones): 1863 BC (no higher-tier year available).

chronologies.citation: Jones, The Chronology of the Old Testament: A Return to the Basics, 23rd ed. (Master Books, 2026), Appendix F, printed p. 278 (PDF p. 313)
chronologies.note: Not stated in the Jones sources previously read (Chart No. 1; 15th ed., 2002). The 23rd ed. Appendix F prints this figure.

chronologies.citation: Ussher, Annals of the World, Third Age §90 (paragraph numbering of the modern transcription)
chronologies.note: §91: "Josephus says that at this time Isaac was 25 years old."

chronologies.date: 2130? - God tells Abraham to take Isaac into the land, to Mount Moriah near Jerusalem, and offer him as a sacrifice.
chronologies.citation: Jordan, "The Chronology of the Pentateuch (Part 4)," Biblical Chronology 6:6 (June 1994), §11 "The Life of Abraham" (year list)

chronologies.note: Josephus gives Isaac's age, not a year; 2108 + 25 = AM 2133 (Ussher's date).
